New Delhi, 27th October 2026

Highlights of Telecom Subscription Data at the end of September 
2026 
 In the month of September 2026, 16.77 million subscribers submitted their 
requests for Mobile Number Portability (MNP).        
 The number of active wireless (mobile) subscribers (on the date of peak VLR#) 
in September 2026 were 1212.80 million. 
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ 
Note: 
*  The wireless subscriber base comprises of wireless mobile telephone subscribers (including M2M cellular mobile connections), and FWA 
subscribers. 
@ Tele-density has been computed on the basis of the projection of population from the ‘Report of the Technical Group on Population 
Projections for India and States 2011 – 2036’, published in September 2020.  
# VLR is an acronym of Visitor Location Register. The dates of peak VLR for various Telecom Service Providers (TSPs) September be different 
in different service areas. 
 Information in this press release is based on the data provided by the Telecom Service Providers (TSPs) to TRAI.

II. Wireline Telephone Subscriber Base 
 The number of wireline subscribers increased from 48.45 million at the end of 
August 2026 to 48.74 million at the end of September 2026. The net increase 
in the wireline subscriber base was 0.29 million with a monthly growth rate 
of 0.60%.   
 The overall wireline tele-density in India increased from 3.39% at the end of 
August 2026 to 3.40% at the of September 2026. Urban and rural wireline 
tele-density were 8.38% and 0.58% respectively, at the end of September 
2026. The respective share of urban subscribers, and rural subscribers in 
total wireline subscribers were 89.09% and 10.91% respectively at the end of 
September 2026. 
 PSU access service providers viz. BSNL, MTNL, and APSFL together held 
15.91% of the wireline market share at the end of September 2026. Detailed 
statistics of the wireline subscriber base are available at Annexure-I.

III. Wireless Telephone (Mobile + FWA) Subscriber Base 
 
 The number of wireless (mobile + Fixed 
Wireless Access) subscribers increased 
from 1312.25 million at the end of 
August 2026 to 1319.19 million at the 
end of September 2026, thereby 
registering a monthly growth rate of 
0.53%. Total wireless subscription in 
urban areas increased from 759.11 
million at the end of August 2026 to 
764.35 million at the end of September 
2026. The subscription in rural areas 
also increased from 553.14 million to 
554.84 million during the same period. 
The monthly growth rate of urban and 
rural wireless subscriptions was 0.69% 
and 0.31%, respectively.   
  The wireless tele-density in India 
increased from 91.69% at the end of August 
2026 to 92.12% at the end of September 
2026. The urban wireless tele-density 
increased from 146.66% at the end of 
August 2026 to 147.47% at the end of 
September 2026. The rural wireless tele-
density increased from 60.55% to 60.72% 
during the same period. The share of urban 
and rural wireless subscribers in the total 
number of wireless subscribers was 
57.94% and 42.06%, respectively, at the 
end of September 2026. 
 
 
Note: In the calculation of Tele-density figures, M2M cellular mobile connections have also been considered. 

RP-2/9/(4)/2025-NSL-II                                                                                                                I/45442/2026

 (B) Wireless (FWA) subscriber Base  
 At present, fixed wireless access (FWA) based services are being provided 
under two categories viz.  
a) 5G FWA i.e. FWA using 5G radio access technology; and  
b) UBR FWA i.e. FWA using Unlicensed Band Radio (UBR) technology.  
 The number of wireless (5G FWA) subscribers increased from 13.45 million 
at the end of August 2026 to 13.61 million at the end of September 2026 
with subscriptions in urban and rural areas as 6.54 million and 7.06 
million respectively. The shares of urban and rural wireless (5G FWA) 
subscribers in total wireless (5G FWA) subscribers were 48.11% and 
51.89% respectively, at the end of September 2026.  
 LSA wise information on the wireless (5G FWA) subscriber base is available 
at Annexure-V.  
 The number of total wireless FWA subscribers using UBR technology (UBR 
FWA) stood at 5.58 million at the end of September 2026 with 
subscriptions in urban and rural areas of 3.95 million and 1.63 million 
respectively. The shares of urban and rural wireless (UBR FWA) 
subscribers in total wireless (UBR FWA) subscribers were 70.74% and 
29.26% respectively, at the end of September 2026.  
 LSA wise information on the wireless (UBR FWA) subscriber base is 
available at Annexure-VI.
